detail.title: Foundation Assumption Testing: Evaluating Automated Axiom Discovery
detail.summary: This cycle reviews the inconclusive status of hypothesis hyp-assump-01 and the project proj-assump-test-01. Given the unavailability of source-dfc7d466ee7d4858, research direction will pivot to re-evaluating the empirical basis of assumption identification using the collected sources, specifically focusing on the black-box algorithmic risks documented in Ethics and Information Technology (source-d2bb360f61c34030).
